premise: A magnetar-class field is available on demand at a space-based source. This is assumed, not assessed.

processes.name: Forging
cells: The driven surface melts or boils within the pulse, so the part is shaped through a liquid-metal skin and a shock: 'magnetohydrodynamic' finally describes it, and surface finish and dimensions are lost.
The pressure exceeds the bulk modulus: the metal is shock-compressed to a fraction of its volume and comes back as hot liquid or vapour. No forged shape survives.
The piston pressure makes degenerate matter and the field, where it gets in, squeezes atoms into needles. Forging has no meaning.
The sample becomes white-dwarf matter and explodes when the field lets go. Forging has no meaning.

processes.name: Refractory metals
cells: Strength stops mattering: the pressure is several to hundreds of times any flow stress, and tungsten fails the same way copper does, by losing its skin.
Refractory and soft metals behave alike: neither strength nor melting point registers against megabar pressure.
Only nuclear charge and mass number distinguish materials.
Only nuclear charge and mass number distinguish materials, and above the capture threshold not even the charge is conserved.

processes.name: Welding
cells: Flyers leave at several to tens of kilometres per second, far beyond any weld window: the joint is a hypervelocity impact crater.
Flyers reach tens of kilometres per second and both parts vaporise on impact. Nothing is joined.
Both parts are plasma before they meet.
Both parts are degenerate plasma before they meet.

processes.name: Synthesis
cells: Shock and ramp compression to tens and hundreds of gigapascals: diamond, lonsdaleite and other dense phases form in nanoseconds, as in flux-compression and Z-pinch experiments today. Recovering the product is the hard part.
Planetary-core pressures, megabars and up: metallic hydrogen and other dense phases exist while the pulse lasts and not after.

'Magnetic chemistry': where the field threads matter, atoms bind into chains along it with tens to hundreds of electronvolts per atom, but only while the field is on. As a piston it makes degenerate matter.
Nuclear, not chemical, synthesis: degenerate electrons are forced into nuclei above each capture threshold and light elements fuse. The product is neutron-rich isotopes and a thermonuclear yield.

processes.name: Densification
cells: Every pore is crushed, together with the surface of the part.
Every pore is crushed, and so is the part.
Porosity has no meaning in degenerate matter.
Porosity has no meaning in degenerate matter.

processes.name: Containment
cells: No structure contains the field statically: the pressure exceeds every material strength, so the source is destroyed each shot, as single-turn coils and flux-compression generators are.
No structure contains the field: it is held only by the inertia of an imploding liner, for microseconds.
Nothing material holds the field; unheld it disperses in the light-crossing time. Nature's only static holder is a neutron star.
Nothing material holds the field; unheld it disperses in the light-crossing time. Nature's only static holder is a neutron star.

thresholds.label: pressure reaches the static yield strength
thresholds.state: solid, flowing plastically wherever the load is uneven (the regime of the rest of magform)

thresholds.label: eddy-current skin starts to melt
thresholds.state: solid inside a molten eddy-current skin: the driven surface is a conducting liquid

thresholds.label: skin reaches its boiling point
thresholds.state: the skin reaches its boiling point within the pulse and starts to blow off as vapour

thresholds.label: skin completely vaporised
thresholds.state: the whole skin depth is vaporised and expands as a conducting plasma

thresholds.label: pressure equals the bulk modulus
thresholds.state: compressed to a fraction of its volume (megabar dynamic compression) and released as hot liquid or vapour

thresholds.label: pressure equals the atomic unit E_h/a0^3
thresholds.state: pressure-ionised: electron shells are crushed and the workpiece is a dense plasma, degenerate like the outer layers of a white dwarf as the pressure rises

thresholds.label: field equals the atomic unit B0
thresholds.state: where the field threads the matter, atoms are squeezed into needles along it and ordinary chemistry stops

thresholds.label: degenerate electrons turn relativistic (x = 1)
thresholds.state: white-dwarf matter: a relativistically degenerate electron gas denser than 1e9 kg/m^3

thresholds.label: field equals the QED critical field
thresholds.state: the field is beyond the quantum-electrodynamic critical value: an electron's cyclotron energy exceeds its rest energy and the vacuum itself is birefringent

thresholds.label: degenerate electrons reach the capture threshold
thresholds.state: degenerate electrons are forced into nuclei: 56Fe starts turning into 56Mn and the workpiece is being transmuted

thresholds.label: pressure equals the neutron-drip pressure
thresholds.state: neutrons drip out of the nuclei: the matter of a neutron star's inner crust

standoff.label: Field falls to the Earth's own
